material_findings: gemma3_fineweb_edu_replication_v21_contract.py:775-812 validate_review_receipt uses dictionary equality against boolean True findings and does not enforce a closed-world receipt key set. Python treats integer 1 as equal to True, so a receipt without explicit boolean finding values, or with arbitrary additional fields, can authorize execution.

validate_gemma3_fineweb_edu_replication_v21.py:780-802 common and 1323-1366 validate_result enforce required subsets but not exact schemas for config.json, results.json, receipt.json, or assessment_per_document rows. Self-digests bind but do not prohibit extra fields, so unvalidated raw tokens, logits, activations, or other non-aggregate payloads can be added and transactionally published.

validate_gemma3_fineweb_edu_replication_v21.py:1070-1091 validate_validator_receipt also uses equality for required boolean fields and lacks an exact key-set check. Integer 1 values for validator_valid or custody_recomputed and arbitrary additional receipt fields remain accepted after self-digest recomputation.
disposition: V21 sealed without an acceptance receipt, acquisition, model effects, or published result. A fresh V22 identity is required for correction.
